BiblicalUsage: Shema is a town in the south of Judah, listed among the cities of the tribe: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah. One verse names it, and the list is its whole story.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the towns in the lists are not filler. Shema was a real place where real families lived, and I hold that God counts the towns as well as the tribes.
